An independent SymPy matrix reconstruction obtained exactly the six displayed generating functions for all forbidden orbits; this is distinct from simply trusting verify.py logs. Five positive dominant growth constants (including unit polynomial rate) follow from the rational poles. Quantifiers: every k>=1 and each of the 16 length-four factors; no claim at longer lengths or multiple patterns.
